cohort: 257 women with eclampsia managed at the University of Abuja Teaching Hospital, Abuja over a 10-year period (out of 22,945 deliveries).
finding: The prevalence of eclampsia was 1.12%, with maternal and perinatal mortality rates of 4.6% and 11.1%, respectively.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 82.2% of cases.
gest_age: Not specified, although gestational age at presentation was recorded.
